text: and this area where i said we want to use predefined values, i want you to make this a dropdown select and not a pill select because if this panel has a ton of data suddenly this becomes a warzone of pill landmines everywhere  [Image #1]
resolution: Changed the inspector surface-default preset UI from horizontal pills to a compact dropdown/select mock. The select opens inline, marks the active preset, updates mock state, and DESIGN_INTAKE.md now records that dense property defaults should use dropdowns rather than pill rows.
